## Summary

I successfully resolved ticket T-2003. The catalog-search pods were stuck in a CrashLoopBackOff because the liveness probe was terminating containers before they could finish loading their index data into memory (~12.4 GiB across 48 shards). The pod logs showed containers receiving SIGTERM signals while only partially through the initialization process.

The fix is to add a **startup probe** to the deployment configuration with sufficient timeout to allow the index loading to complete (at least 600 seconds based on the observed load rate). This will prevent the liveness probe from triggering until the application is fully initialized, while still maintaining fast failure detection once the service is running. The ticket owner should update the deployment spec and redeploy to resolve the issue.
